'''Chandra''' was, along with [[Chandrakant/Legends|Chandrakant]], one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Along with the rest of the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector's]] [[Chandrila system/Legends|Chandrila system]],<ref name="SoR" /> it was located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as a dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[Arrowhead]] portions of the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEAChandrila" />

The lifeless terrestrial moon was the larger of Chandrila's natural satellites and was covered in massive craters caused by [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] impacts. The moon had a thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], which caused its barren surface to reflect a [[Color/Legends|lavender]]-colored light, and it loomed impossibly large in Chandrila's skies. Chandra's name meant "point" in the [[Chandrilan (language)/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. Chandrila's moons were said to represent the value of debate and peaceful coexistence, as well as the importance of moving on when a debate was finished.<ref name="SoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The two moons of Chandrila were first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The [[2015]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', published for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="SoR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Chandrila [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Chandra, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEAChandrila" />
